sourceText: Im currently in Madison Wi at a mall security job. I’ve been slowly getting my life back to normal after being homeless from May 3 til August 16 last year. I’ve been at the job since then and now I’ve been at the mall since then. It is currently April 17th and I’m gearing up to go home. My parents said they’re find with me being there for the summer. There are a few conditions though. 1. I got to make my payments on time that I owe them which is $61 for my phone and then another $217 for a loan repayment. This April I have only $70 of that left to pay. I’m getting a student loan for summer expenses and that is expected to land on May 10th. I’m really struggling to stay at the security job so I’m trying to get out of it asap. We have tested junk removal ads which is our plan for making money this summer they have worked everytime we texted them converting at around $50 per customer cost and $100-150 customer profit. Right now I have access to $1300 in capital with $1170 of expenses including all businesses expenses before the student loan hits. I’m bringing my cat who is quite scared of other people and animals. My parents will be gone this weekend the 18tg through 20th so ideally I could go back now what do you think of this plan

Translate to Turkish: "Issue #537: Add chat level prompt subdirectory selector

Status: 🟢 Open
Opened: June 26, 2025
Author: @mustafamohsen (Contributor)
Description

I suggest adding a chat level prompt subdirectory selector. This way it's more modular and use-case based. I think that this is particularly helpful after merging the hacking branch with main.
Discussion
@wojons - July 1, 2025

I am looking for the same feature for chats and for tasks would be great.

The way I see it, per chat level settings being able to also adjust the models being used for a chat would be good - still have the default ones that are global but being able to set a model (and its rate limits) for a chat would be very useful.
@mustafamohsen - July 1, 2025 (Author)

    I am looking for the same feature for chats and for tasks would be great

    The way I see it per chat level settings being able to also adjust the models being used for a chat would be good still have the default ones that are global but being able to set a model (and its rate limits) for a chat would be very useful.

This issue was opened literally a few minutes before 0.9 release, which changed how agents get spawned. At the moment, the prompt selector seem to affect only the primary agent (agent 0), which decides which profile should sub agents follow. So it seems less relevant now as far as I understand.
"
